run_meta.licence_gate: released by MG ruling 30-10-2026 ('yes' to the Stage 4b closer): private hash-verified analysis in scope; DB not redistributed
run_meta.unit_convention: citation mass by normalised siglum = first comma-segment of Sources.Sokr, whitespace-collapsed (pre-registered, declared at compute time)

join_view.note: same 10,318 joined examples as the Stage 4b denominator set

R1.hypothesis: mass per cited siglum is extreme-right-skewed; top decile concentrates, near-zero tail
R1.falsifier: top-decile share < 2x uniform (0.20) OR decile shares linear in rank

R3.hypothesis: source-density rankings on the C-half vs T-half of the SAME dump diverge materially — partial-apparatus artefact demo
R3.falsifier: rankings coincide (rho ~ 1) — metric choice then carries no apparatus artefact
R3.operationalisation: material divergence declared as rho < 0.90 on shared sigla (declared at compute time, before looking: the ONP a-em lesson predicts instability)
R3.adjudication: SUPPORTED (halves diverge: partial-apparatus rankings are apparatus artefacts)

R4.hypothesis: word-, meaning-, example- and row-density-weighted source rankings diverge materially
R4.falsifier: all pairwise rho ~ 1 (coincidence) — metric choice then carries no information
R4.operationalisation: material divergence declared as min pairwise rho < 0.95
R4.adjudication: SUPPORTED (weightings diverge — metric choice carries information)

R2.hypothesis: declared-complete canonical texts show an order-of-magnitude density advantage over same-genre selective sources
R2.pre_declared_fallback: if no declaration is recoverable from the printed front matter, R2 is reclassified UNTESTABLE-ON-THIS-SUBSTRATE before the run, never silently adapted
R2.adjudication: UNTESTABLE-ON-THIS-SUBSTRATE (no declared complete-excerption list recoverable: zero declaration hits in the open-code clone, no excerption-class column in Sources; the printed dictionary's front matter is out-of-band for this run)

R5.hypothesis: which declared sources are never exercised is predictable from genre/date/Lang profile, not random
R5.reason: single class after grouping: essentially every declared source row/group is exercised by joined examples — there is no never-exercised set to predict
R5.observed_inversion: the dump's asymmetry runs OPPOSITE to the ONP shape: exercised (11,477 distinct source IDs across all examples, incl. 14,087 examples citing IDs absent from Sources) >> declared (8,400 rows / ~825 siglum groups) — the Sources table reads as a BY-PRODUCT of the excerpting (a slice-generated list), not an independent catalogue that could have absences
R5.implication: the independence-weakening recorded at Stage 4b is stronger than assumed: corpus side == exercised side on this substrate
